name: lufs-web-sampler
description: A browser-native sampler — Koala's soul, honestly scoped to the web — built on a verifiable, portable DSP core.

scripts.build: npm run fonts && npm run build --workspace @lufs/web-sampler-app && python3 scripts/render-adapters.py packages/app/dist site
scripts.ci: npm run precheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify
